title: Android Automation Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

The Nemetschek Group is a leading global vertical software and AI provider driving the digital transformation of the AEC/O and media industries. With our deep domain expertise and intelligent, connected software solutions, we enable customers to turn data into real-time insights and smarter decisions throughout the entire lifecycle of buildings and infrastructure from ideation through planning, visualization, construction, operation, and renovation.  
Our AI-powered technologies and open standards approach boost productivity, collaboration, and sustainability for architects, engineers, contractors, building operators, and creative professionals. Over 7 million users worldwide rely on our customer-centric, human-led AI solutions. Founded by Professor Georg Nemetschek in 1963, today we employ over 4,000 experts globally across 14 subsidiaries.

 **Job Description**

An Automation Engineer (Android) builds and maintains the automated tests and tooling that keep our Android app stable and releases on schedule. The role centers on using Appium with TypeScript (e.g. WebdriverIO) to automate native Android app workflows on emulators and real devices, backed by API checks that validate what happens behind the UI. AI coding agents (Copilot, Cursor, etc.) are part of the daily routine, used to write tests faster, investigate failures, and keep suites maintainable over time. This engineer owns Android testing for their product areas and decides how best to cover them, while sharing frameworks, standards, and code reviews with the wider automation team.

* Design and develop automated tests for Android app features, workflows, and regression testing using Appium and TypeScript.
* Implement and maintain test frameworks, and tools, including screen objects, device and capability configuration, and shared utilities.
* Collaborate with Android developers and cross-functional teams to improve app testability (e.g. stable accessibility IDs) and identify automation opportunities.
* Troubleshoot, stabilize, and enhance existing automated tests, with a focus on reducing flakiness caused by timing, device state, and environment issues.
* Ensure automated solutions align with business and technical requirements.
* Integrate mobile tests into release pipelines, including app build handling and emulator or device provisioning, and help keep them reliable.
* Stay up to date on emerging AI technologies and mobile testing best practices.

Required Qualifications:

* Strong proficiency in TypeScript, with hands-on experience automating native Android apps using Appium (UiAutomator2 driver) and WebdriverIO or a similar client.
* Solid working knowledge of the Android platform: app lifecycle, permissions, ADB, Android Studio, emulators (AVDs), and inspecting UI hierarchies with tools such as Appium Inspector.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines in GitHub and/or GitLab, including running mobile test suites on emulators or device clouds.
* Independently diagnose and resolve complex test failures using device logs (logcat), screenshots, and screen recordings.
* Comfortable with API testing and writing SQL to validate backend state, verify data integrity after app and API operations, and manage test data across environments.
* Working skills with at least one coding agent.
* Minimum 4 years in test automation, including at least 2 years automating native Android apps with Appium.
* proven experience setting up frameworks from scratch and building custom tooling, utilities, and integrations to solve testing problems that off-the-shelf solutions don't cover.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and devOps practices.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Ability to work independently and as prat of a team.  

  
  
**Additional Information**

#NemetschekIndia #LI-Hybrid #LI-SM1

title: Technical Lead – Python | GST & Business Software
description:
**About us**

Nylun Global Private Limited is building **GST Pilot**, a GST compliance and business software for businesses and Chartered Accountant firms across India. It will cover **GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9, IMS (Invoice Management System), ITC reconciliation, e-invoice, e-way bill, GST ledgers and reports**.

**Where we are today:** the core modules have been developed as an **advanced working prototype**: a Windows desktop application (Python + Flask) with a cloud licensing and payments system. Our next goal is to make it a **stable, secure, production-ready product** and launch it to the market, then extend it into a **cloud (SaaS) workspace**. More products will follow, including audit and accounting software.

This is the **most exciting stage to join**: you’ll shape the product, the architecture and the team from the ground up.

**Who we are looking for**

We are looking for a **young, energetic and hands-on Technical Lead** who is:

* **hungry for an opportunity to prove themselves**, and wants to take a product from prototype to launch,
* **ambitious to grow** with a fast-growing company and take on bigger responsibility,
* **passionate about technology and AI**, and always learning new tools and better ways of working,
* **a natural leader**, who enjoys teaching, guiding and growing interns and freshers,
* **an owner, not just an employee**, who takes responsibility for results, not only tasks.

If you have the skills and the fire to grow, and you want a place where your work is **seen, valued and rewarded**, this role is for you.

**What you will do**

* **Take GST Pilot from prototype to production:** review the existing code, find gaps, and make the product **stable, secure, tested and ready for real users**.
* **Plan and prioritise:** turn the product roadmap into clear technical tasks and timelines, and track them to completion.
* **Build hands-on** with **Python (Flask), JavaScript, HTML/CSS, SQLite** and a Windows desktop app (WebView2).
* **Strengthen quality:** add automated tests, fix bugs, handle errors properly, and improve reliability and performance.
* **Prepare for launch:** Windows installer, code signing, updates, live payment integration (Razorpay), email and SMS OTP, server setup and security.
* **Improve user experience:** fast loading, correct layout on all screen sizes, smooth handling of large data, good performance on older computers.
* **GST portal integration:** make browser automation and API sessions reliable and secure.
* **Build the cloud version next:** multi-user APIs, PostgreSQL database, secure sync between desktop and cloud, user roles and permissions.
* **Lead with AI:** use AI coding tools every day (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) and build AI-assisted ways of working for the whole team.
* **Lead the team:** plan and assign work to interns and freshers, review their code, train them and help them become productive quickly.
* **Work with our Chartered Accountants:** turn GST and business requirements into accurate, working features.
* **Grow with us:** help plan and build new products as the company expands.

**Must-have skills**

* **6–8 years** of hands-on software development experience.
* **Strong Python**, our core product language, plus experience in **at least one more backend language** such as Node.js, Go, Java or C#/.NET.
* **Backend frameworks:** Flask, FastAPI, Django, Express/NestJS, Gin or similar; good REST API design.
* **Frontend:** JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS; any of vanilla JS, React, Angular or Vue.
* **Databases:** PostgreSQL, MySQL and/or SQLite; good SQL and data-modelling skills.
* **Experience taking software to production:** testing, release, deployment, monitoring and fixing live issues.
* **SaaS / cloud:** experience building or supporting a multi-user cloud application (login, user roles, hosting on AWS, Azure, GCP or Linux servers).
* **AI-first working:** **proactive, daily use of AI coding tools**, with real examples of finishing work faster, and the judgement to check and correct AI-generated code.
* **Team leadership:** experience **guiding interns, freshers or junior developers**: task planning, code reviews, training.
* **Quality:** automated testing (pytest or similar), Git, clean coding practices.
* **Security basics:** encryption, safe storage of passwords and credentials, authentication, input validation.
* Good communication in English. Telugu or Hindi is a plus.

**Good to have**

* **GST, accounting, tax or fintech software experience**: GSTR-1/3B/9, ITC reconciliation, e-invoice, e-way bill, GST portal or GSP APIs.
* **Desktop/Windows applications:** WebView2, Electron, Tauri, .NET WinForms/WPF, PyInstaller/Nuitka, installers (Inno Setup, MSI).
* **Browser automation:** Selenium, Playwright or Puppeteer.
* **Integrations:** payment gateways, SMS gateways (DLT), email services, OAuth / Google sign-in.
* **DevOps:** Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar), Linux server management.
* **Others:** Redis or MongoDB, message queues, Kubernetes, mobile (Flutter / React Native).
* **Startup experience:** taking a product from idea or prototype to first customers.

**No GST knowledge? No problem.** Our Chartered Accountants will train you on the GST rules. We value strong engineering skills, attitude and willingness to learn.

**What we are NOT looking for**

* Someone who only wants to manage and no longer writes code.
* Someone who wants to throw everything away and restart from scratch. We build on the work already done, improving and completing it carefully.
* Someone looking only for a comfortable, routine job. We want people who want to **build, prove and grow**.

**Why join Nylun Global Private Limited**

* **Build a product from prototype to launch:** see your work go live with businesses and CA firms across India.
* **A real opportunity to prove yourself:** your decisions shape the product, the architecture and the team.
* **Fast growth:** a fast path to senior leadership roles for people who perform.
* **Ownership:** you lead the technology and work directly with the founders.
* **AI-first culture:** build a modern, AI-powered engineering team from the beginning.
* **Learning:** learn GST and fintech from experienced Chartered Accountants.
* **New products:** be part of building audit, accounting and more products in future.
* **Competitive salary:** ₹6 – 12 lakh per annum, based on your skills and experience, with performance-based growth.

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

title: Sr. Engineer: Application Security
description:
V – Sr. Engineer: Application Security Position: Senior Security Engineer – AppSec Department: 9909153 - IT Mountain Applications
  
  
Job Summary: The Senior Application Security Engineer acts as the bridge between Information Security and our Software Development teams. This role is responsible for securing the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) by integrating security tooling directly into CI/CD pipelines and performing technical security assessments on proprietary applications.
  
  
Crucially, this role is a cultural leader. You will build and nurture a "Security Champions" program, empowering developers to take ownership of security within their own products. You are not just finding bugs; you are teaching teams how to build secure code by design, fostering a partnership based on trust and mutual goals.
  
  
Who you are:
  
  

* Developer-Centric: You think like a developer because you have been one. You understand the pressure of sprint deadlines and strive to make security "frictionless."
* Relationship Builder: You know that the best way to secure software is to have the developers on your side. You approach vulnerability discussions with empathy and a "how do we fix this together" attitude.
* Curious & Technical: You love digging into code logic to find the flaw that automated scanners missed.
* Teacher & Mentor: You enjoy explaining why a Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability is dangerous and demonstrating how to write the code to prevent it.
* Pragmatic: You can distinguish between a theoretical risk and a practical exploit, helping business leaders make informed shipping decisions.

Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Security Champions Program: Help to launch, and manage a formal Security Champions program. Identify key advocates within development teams, provide them with advanced training, and build a community of practice.
* Secure SDLC (DevSecOps): Engineer and maintain the integration of security testing tools (SAST, DAST, SCA) into the CI/CD pipeline (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab) to provide rapid feedback to developers.
* Application Security Testing: Conduct manual and automated penetration tests and code reviews on web applications, APIs, and mobile apps prior to release.
* Threat Modeling: Partner with engineering teams during the architecture/design phase to perform threat modeling (STRIDE/PASTA), identifying design flaws before code is even written.
* Vulnerability Management (AppSec): Triaging results from application scans, removing false positives, and creating clear, actionable Jira tickets for engineering teams.
* Developer Training: Create and deliver secure coding training (e.g., OWASP Top 10) tailored to the specific technology stacks used by the organization.
* Tool Engineering: Evaluate application security technologies and their reports (e.g., Stackhawk, or Qualys WAS).
* Policy & Standards: Assist in developing application security standards and coding guidelines that align with industry frameworks (ASVS, NIST). Experience you’ll need:
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information security, or equivalent experience.
* Development Background: Significant experience in software development or scripting (e.g., Java, .NET/C#, Python, JavaScript/Node.js). You must be able to read and understand the code you are securing.
* AppSec Expertise: Deep understanding of the OWASP Top 10, SANS 25, and common attack vectors (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, IDOR) and their remediations.
* Pipeline Engineering: Hands-on experience integrating security tools into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Tool Proficiency: Experience with SAST (Static Analysis), DAST (Dynamic Analysis), and SCA (Software Composition Analysis) tools.
* Cultural Leadership: Demonstrated experience building relationships with development teams or leading "Security Champions" initiatives.
* API Security: Strong understanding of API security, JSON Web Tokens (JWT), and API gateways.
* Communication: Ability to explain complex security exploits to non-security audiences and influence stakeholders to prioritize technical debt.
* Cloud Native Security: Familiarity with securing cloud-native applications (containers, Kubernetes, Serverless) in AWS or Azure. Preferred Experience:
* Certifications: CASE (Certified Application Security Engineer), CSSLP, GWEB, or OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional).
* Experience with Qualys Web App Scanning (WAS) module.
* Experience with "Infrastructure as Code" (IaC) security scanning (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
* Contribution to open-source security projects or bug bounty programs.

title: Senior / Lead UI/UX Designer (Web & Mobile Applications)
description:
**Job Title:** Senior / Lead Product Designer (UI/UX)

**Department:** Product Design & User Experience

**Experience Level:** 5 – 10 Years

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Purpose

We are looking for a visionary, user-obsessed, and versatile **Senior UI/UX Designer** with 5 to 10 years of experience designing high-impact digital products across both **web applications and mobile platforms (iOS & Android)**.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end design lifecycle of our core digital products—transforming complex workflows and ambiguous business problems into seamless, intuitive, and visually stunning user experiences. You will bridge user research, interaction design, and visual craftsmanship while collaborating closely with product managers and engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Product Design (Web & Mobile)

* **Web App Design:** Architect scalable, data-dense, and responsive web application interfaces (dashboards, SaaS platforms, complex data workflows) optimized for performance and usability.
* **Mobile App Design:** Design native mobile application experiences (iOS & Android) adhering to Human Interface Guidelines (HIG) and Material Design principles, focusing on touch targets, thumb zones, and mobile-first micro-interactions.
* **User Journey & Architecture:** Create information architectures, user flows, wireframes, and interactive low-to-high fidelity prototypes to test and validate concepts quickly.

2. User Research & Data-Driven Strategy

* **Discovery & Testing:** Conduct user interviews, surveys, usability testing sessions, and competitive audits to uncover deep user needs, pain points, and behavioral insights.
* **Continuous Iteration:** Analyze post-launch product analytics, heatmaps, and funnel drop-offs to drive continuous, data-backed design improvements.

3. UI Craftsmanship & Design Systems

* **Visual Excellence:** Deliver pixel-perfect UI layouts, typography structures, and accessible color schemes that elevate brand identity across all device screens.
* **Design System Ownership:** Build, scale, and maintain comprehensive cross-platform Design Systems and component libraries (tokens, responsive grids, shared UI kits) in Figma to ensure design consistency between web and mobile.
* **Accessibility (a11y):** Ensure designs meet **WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA** standards for web and mobile accessibility.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership

* **Engineering Handoff:** Partner seamlessly with frontend and mobile developers, providing detailed specs,responsive layout rules, and design tokens to ensure flawless implementation.
* **Stakeholder Alignment:** Present design strategies and rationales clearly to product leaders and executive stakeholders.
* **Mentorship:** Guide and mentor junior/mid-level designers on best practices for cross-platform app design.

Required Technical Skills & Qualifications

* **Experience:** 5 to 10 years of professional UI/UX design experience, with a proven, verifiable track record of launching and scaling **both web applications and mobile apps**.
* **Portfolio Requirement:** A comprehensive portfolio showcasing live web apps and mobile apps, detailing your end-to-end design process (research, wireframes, user testing, design system usage, and final screens).
* **Design Tools:** Expert-level mastery of **Figma** (Advanced Auto Layout, component variants, cross-platform prototyping). Familiarity with user testing and analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Hotjar, Maze).
* **Technical Literacy:** Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and modern frontend/mobile constraints (React,Flutter, or native iOS/Android layout logic) to ensure seamless engineering collaboration.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Interaction Design, Graphic Design, or equivalent practical experience.

Soft Skills & Professional Attributes

* **Systems Thinker:** Ability to look at a product holistically and design seamless cross-device experiences (desktop to mobile transitions).
* **Problem Solver:** Exceptional ability to simplify complex logic into frictionless user flows.
* **Communication & Empathy:** Strong storytelling and advocacy skills to champion the user's voice across the organization.

title: Senior IOS Engineer
description:
### **Description**

We are looking for a highly skilled iOS/tvOS Developer to join our team and take a leading role in building and enhancing our OTT video streaming applications. Your primary responsibility will be to develop and optimize a custom video player experience for both iOS and tvOS, leveraging AVPlayer and related media frameworks. You will collaborate closely with product, design, and backend engineering teams to deliver a seamless, high-performance user experience.

  

### **What you'll be doing:**

  

* Design, develop, and maintain OTT streaming applications for iOS and tvOS using Swift.
* Build and optimize a custom AVPlayer-based video player, including playback controls, UI layers, gesture handling, and state management.
* Implement features such as Multiview, DRM, subtitles/closed captions, adaptive bitrate streaming (HLS), and background playback.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to create intuitive and visually polished user interfaces.
* Integrate with backend APIs for content catalog, analytics, and player events.
* Ensure high performance, low memory usage, and smooth playback on both iOS and tvOS devices.
* Debug and resolve complex playback issues, buffering/latency problems, and platform-specific behaviors.
* Write clean, maintainable code following best architectural practices.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving overall engineering standards.
* Stay up to date with Apple platform updates, new APIs, and best practices.

### **What you'll bring:**

  

* 5–7+ years of professional experience in Swift development.
* Strong expertise with AVPlayer, AVFoundation, HLS streaming, and media playback architecture.
* Proven experience building and releasing iOS and/or tvOS applications.
* Solid understanding of UI frameworks (UIKit; SwiftUI is a plus).
* Experience with performance optimization, memory profiling, and debugging tools (Instruments, Console, etc.).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON parsing, and networking frameworks (URLSession, Combine, etc.).
* Experience implementing subtitles, DRM (FairPlay), and custom playback logic.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

### **About DAZN**

At DAZN, we bring ambition to life. We are innovators, game-changers and pioneers. So, if you want to push boundaries and make an impact, DAZN is the place to be.

As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make your mark and the power to make change happen. We're doing things no-one has done before, giving fans and customers access to sport anytime, anywhere. We're using world-class technology to transform sports and revolutionise the industry and we're not going to stop.

**DAZN VALUES – THE ‘HOW’ IN WHAT WE DO:**

Agility and creativity fuel growth and innovation, to **Make It Happen.**

Prioritising what matters drives progress and positive outcomes, **Focusing On Impact.**

Collective ambition builds optimism and success, in order to **Win As One.**

At DAZN, we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values equality and diversity, where everyone can contribute and have their voices heard. This means hiring and developing talent across all races, ethnicities, religions, age groups, sexual orientations, gender identities and abilities.

If you’d like to include a cover letter with your application, please feel free to. Please do not feel you need to apply with a photo or disclose any other information that is not related to your professional experience.

Our aim is to make our hiring processes as accessible for everyone as possible, including providing adjustments for interviews where we can.

We look forward to hearing from you.
